stored_text.note: The only stored file has role 'secondary', but it is the page of the Ministry of Science and Technology, the lead issuer. It carries the transmittal notice 国科发监〔2023〕167号 (dated 2023年9月7日, published 2023年10月08日) and the full Chinese text: 56 articles and the annex list. The gov.cn copy (role official) was not stored (robots.txt unreachable). The record's verification.note says the gov.cn page was fetched; the stored evidence is the MOST page.

english_version.publisher: Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET), Georgetown University
english_version.note: One web search found no English version on most.gov.cn or from another public body. The web lead is CSET's third-party translation; China Justice Observer uses the English title 'Measures for Scientific and Technological Ethics Review (for Trial Implementation)'. Neither is stored.

title.source_quote: 科技伦理审查办法（试行）
title.why: Literally 'Science-and-technology ethics review measures (trial)'. '(Trial)' for 试行 is standard; 'for Trial Implementation' is a common alternative.

summary_claims.claim: It requires algorithms, models and systems to follow fairness, transparency, reliability and controllability principles.
summary_claims.original_quote: 算法、模型和系统的设计、实现、应用等遵守公平、公正、透明、可靠、可控等原则，符合国家有关要求
summary_claims.literal_translation: the design, implementation, application etc. of algorithms, models and systems comply with principles such as fairness, impartiality, transparency, reliability and controllability, and meet relevant state requirements
summary_claims.note: This is one of the criteria that ethics committees apply when they review S&T activities involving data and algorithms (Art. 15: 按照以下重点内容和标准开展审查), not a free-standing duty. The summary also drops 公正 (impartiality). Both are nuances; the meaning holds.

summary_claims.claim: Its annex lists activities needing expert re-review, three of them AI-related: human-machine fusion systems that strongly affect behaviour, emotions or health ...
summary_claims.original_quote: 5. 对人类主观行为、心理情绪和生命健康等具有较强影响的人机融合系统的研发。
summary_claims.literal_translation: 5. Research and development of human-machine fusion systems that have a strong influence on human subjective behaviour, psychological emotions, life and health, etc.

summary_claims.claim: ... algorithms and systems able to mobilise public opinion or guide social consciousness ...
summary_claims.original_quote: 6. 具有舆论社会动员能力和社会意识引导能力的算法模型、应用程序及系统的研发。
summary_claims.literal_translation: 6. Research and development of algorithmic models, applications and systems that have the capacity for public-opinion social mobilisation and the capacity to guide social consciousness.
summary_claims.note: The text joins the two capacities with 和 (and); the summary says 'or'. 'Able to mobilise public opinion' compresses 舆论社会动员能力. The meaning is kept. Item 7 (具有高度自主能力的自动化决策系统 in 存在安全、人身健康风险等场景) also matches the summary.

key_terms.note: 复核 means re-examination or second review; the annex heading is 需要开展伦理审查复核的科技活动清单 (list of S&T activities requiring re-examination of the ethics review). The procedure is in Arts. 25-34.
Literally 'S&T ethics (review) committee'. Art. 4 makes universities, research institutes, medical institutions and enterprises set up their own, so 'institutional' is accurate.

note: The annex's AI items are 5 to 7, as the summary says. Dates in the notes match the MOST page (成文日期 2023年09月07日, 发布日期 2023年10月08日; Art. 56 effective 2023年12月1日).
